scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind edit a worksheet.
Cell: is one box in a worksheet. Row: runs horizontally across a sheet.
Column: runs vertically down a sheet. Formula: calculates a result using values. Workbook: is a saved file containing one or more worksheets.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Cell, Row and Column; explain what each means.
